subject: SOURCE/PLATFORM FINDING: Duo present callback is not exact native-cover landing proof
body: WORKSTREAM_ID=ws-performance-rd-terminal-handoff-budget-20261001T231122Z. Revalidated against main 45bb0d326899c0e08415928224cfea0ff58d2d4e. Current <=12deg native-cover transition emits HideMirror+ReleaseSecondary and coordinator detaches the host immediately, with no destination presentation condition. Important correction to terminal-barrier semantics: Android ViewTreeObserver frame-commit is only swap-chain submission; Display.getState is display power/state; SurfaceControl.Transaction.addTransactionCompletedListener is exact presentation evidence for the transaction to which the listener is attached. Duo Open attaches that listener to its own mirror/geometry transaction. It therefore cannot, by public API contract alone, prove that Samsung/native cover application content from another surface tree has presented behind the overlay. Evidence classes must remain distinct: ROUTE_OBSERVED, VIEW_FRAME_COMMIT, DUO_TRANSACTION_PRESENTED, NATIVE_CONTENT_PRESENTED. Only the last is safe as an unconditional early native-landing release signal. If no OEM/privileged exact native-content event is proven, terminal handoff must be explicitly degraded+bounds-based rather than relabeling a Duo callback as native proof. No production writes.

applies_to.package: Gen3 terminal native-cover handoff performance/evidence R&D
